caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical tin container with a lid, primarily rendered in blue tones with various decorative details. The front of the tin features a large, prominently displayed eagle with outstretched wings colored in shades of brown and white, positioned above a rectangular red and gold pedestal. A banner unfurls above the eagle with the words "PUTNAM AND ROFF. PAPER HANGING &" written in black on a white background. On the pedestal below the eagle, it reads, "MANUFAC BOX BAND HARTFORD CON." Each side of the pedestal is flanked by green leafy branches with red berries. The rim of the lid is illustrated with a decorative border featuring alternating blue and white patterns, and the lid itself extends the eagle motif, showing a continuation of the eagle's wing and banner. The background of the tin is shaded in multiple blues, with the eagle, banners, and leafy decorations providing contrast in reds, browns, greens, and whites. The composition centers the eagle and its associated elements, with the plant designs filling space on either side.
title: Bandbox
